contexts.text: The things which are of life, are represented in Heaven by rosebeds, etc.
Like a dead body covered over with roses, etc.
Sitting by threes and tens on rosebeds.
We have lain down upon this rose bed.
From her necklace hung a rosary of chrysolites.
Garlands of lilies and roses of a hyacinthine colour... adorned their bosoms.
Like a rose bed in the spring time.
Seven women seen sitting on a rose bed.
The rose bed on which we sit = the deliciousnesses of wisdom.
She wove a garland of roses, sprinkled it with water from the fountain, and placed it on the boy's hat... and said, Receive the deliciousnesses of intelligence...

I again saw those seven wives in a rosary, but not in the same one. It was a magnificent rosary... round, and the roses formed a rainbowgreen or bright green: and within this rainbow rosary there was a little lake of limpid water... Such a thing is created by the Lord in a moment, and represents something new on the earth... we think it is the deliciousnesses of conjugial love. Explained. CL 294:3.
A hat on the crown of which was a rosary surrounded with small sapphires.

The commonness, when there is love truly conjugial, is the plane in which the deliciousnesses form themselves from within, as upon the plane of the rose, and each rose becomes a plane, in which are formed interior deliciousnesses to eternity.
